> This seems pretty reasonable. It wouldn't be that hard to do blygs on private GitHub repos. It would likely have to be stuff that's not super sensitive and wouldn't be the end of the world if share. More frieNDA than nsa.

Why? Most intranets have sharepoint or other company wide repos with NDA level sensitive info, not frieNDA. If a corporate network of blygs runs entirely within the firewall, I think we get an enterprise communications bus of sorts. 

I'm going to try and design a permissions systems for blygs soon into the spec, so people can implement things like access controls and paywall gates.
content_html:
This seems pretty reasonable. It wouldn't be that hard to do blygs on private GitHub repos. It would likely have to be stuff that's not super sensitive and wouldn't be the end of the world if share. More frieNDA than nsa.

Why? Most intranets have sharepoint or other company wide repos with NDA level sensitive info, not frieNDA. If a corporate network of blygs runs entirely within the firewall, I think we get an enterprise communications bus of sorts.

I'm going to try and design a permissions systems for blygs soon into the spec, so people can implement things like access controls and paywall gates.
